stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h1>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">有些信息只值得告诉 Agent 一次：你习惯的 commit message 写法、项目用的包管理器、团队的评审约定。<strong class="font-medium text-foreground">Memory</strong> 为 ZCode Agent 提供项目级的长期记忆，让这类信息延续到后续会话，而不需要每次对话开头都重复交代。</p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">开启后，ZCode 会在每轮对话成功结束后于后台回顾最近的交流，判断是否有值得长期保留的内容——你的偏好、你对 Agent 工作方式的纠正、项目目标与约束、你提供过的外部资料。保存下来的记忆会在同一项目的后续会话中自动带入上下文。</p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">你也可以在对话中直接管理记忆：说「记住，我们从 staging 分支发布」即可立刻保存；说「忘掉刚才说的发布分支」即可删除对应记忆。</p>
<blockquote class="border-l-4 border-border bg-muted/5 px-4 py-2 italic text-muted-foreground mb-4">
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">Memory 默认关闭</strong>，需要 ZCode v3.6.4 及以上版本，按下一节的方式开启。</p>
</blockquote>
<hr class="my-8 border-t border-border"/>
<h2 class="group min-w-0 text-3xl font-medium mt-12 mb-4 text-foreground" id="enable">开启 Memory<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h2>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">打开 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">设置 → 常规</strong>，找到 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">Memory</strong> 开关并打开。</p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">关于这个开关有两点需要了解：</p>
<ul class="mb-4 list-disc list-outside pl-5 text-sm">
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">只对新会话生效</strong>。修改设置影响新建会话和应用重启后恢复的会话；进行中的对话保持原有设定。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">可能增加 Token 用量</strong>。开启后，系统可能发起额外的模型请求来提取和召回长期记忆，可以在<a class="text-primary underline decoration-primary/80 transition-colors hover:decoration-primary" href="/cn/docs/usage-stats">使用统计</a>中关注消耗情况。</li>
</ul>
<hr class="my-8 border-t border-border"/>
<h2 class="group min-w-0 text-3xl font-medium mt-12 mb-4 text-foreground" id="what">会记住什么<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h2>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">Memory 聚焦四类信息：</p>
<div class="mb-6 overflow-x-auto rounded-md border border-border bg-card"><table class="min-w-full border-collapse text-sm"><thead class="bg-muted/60 text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.1em] text-muted-foreground"><tr class="bg-transparent"><th class="border-b border-border px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground" style="text-align:left">类型</th><th class="border-b border-border px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground" style="text-align:left">覆盖内容</th><th class="border-b border-border px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground" style="text-align:left">示例</th></tr></thead><tbody class="bg-card"><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">用户</strong></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">你的身份、专长和偏好</td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">「习惯用 pnpm 和 Conventional Commits」</td></tr><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">反馈</strong></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">对 Agent 工作方式的纠正或确认</td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">「不要顺手修改无关文件里的 lint 报错」</td></tr><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">项目</strong></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">项目目标、约束与进展</td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">「站点需要保持兼容 Node 20」</td></tr><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">参考</strong></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">你提供过的外部资源</td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">「设计规范在团队 Wiki 的某个链接」</td></tr></tbody></table></div>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">同样重要的是 Memory 刻意<strong class="font-medium text-foreground">不记</strong>的内容：代码结构和 Git 历史（Agent 随时可以重新读取）、项目指令文件里已有的内容，以及只在当前对话内有效的临时信息。</p>
<hr class="my-8 border-t border-border"/>
<h2 class="group min-w-0 text-3xl font-medium mt-12 mb-4 text-foreground" id="how-it-works">工作机制<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h2>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">一轮对话成功结束后，后台流程会回顾最近的交流。如果发现值得保留的信息，就把它写成一个小的 Markdown 事实文件，并更新 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">MEMORY.md</code> 索引；没有则什么都不保存。整个过程发生在你的回合结束之后，不会拖慢对话本身。</p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">在同一项目的后续会话里，索引会自动加载进 Agent 的上下文，无需任何手动操作。记忆按<strong class="font-medium text-foreground">项目隔离</strong>：ZCode 在一个工作区学到的内容不会带到另一个工作区。</p>
<hr class="my-8 border-t border-border"/>
<h2 class="group min-w-0 text-3xl font-medium mt-12 mb-4 text-foreground" id="storage">记忆存在哪里<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h2>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">记忆是保存在你本机的普通 Markdown 文件：</p>
<pre class="rounded-lg bg-muted/60 mt-2 mb-4 p-4 overflow-auto border border-border"><code class="block text-foreground font-mono text-sm leading-relaxed language-text">~/.zcode/cli/memories/projects/&lt;project&gt;/memory/
├── MEMORY.md        # 索引，一行一条
└── *.md             # 每条事实一个文件
</code></pre>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">Memory 功能本身不会把这些内容上传到任何地方。由于就是普通文件，你随时可以手动打开、编辑或删除；删除项目的记忆目录即可完全重置该项目的记忆。</p>
<hr class="my-8 border-t border-border"/>
<h2 class="group min-w-0 text-3xl font-medium mt-12 mb-4 text-foreground" id="limits">限制与说明<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h2>
<ul class="mb-4 list-disc list-outside pl-5 text-sm">
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">默认关闭</strong>：按项目的工作流需要在「设置 → 常规」中开启。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">暂无 App 内管理页面</strong>：想查看或清理记忆，可以在对话里问 Agent（「你记住了这个项目的哪些信息？」/「忘掉……」），或直接编辑磁盘上的记忆文件。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">暂不支持远程工作区</strong>：当前版本仅对本地项目执行记忆提取。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">索引加载有大小上限</strong>：记忆过多时会被截断，简短的条目效果最好——自动提取本身也会保持条目精炼。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">与 MCP memory server 不是一回事</strong>：Memory 是 ZCode 内置能力，无需任何 MCP 配置即可使用；如果你已在用记忆类 MCP 工具，两者相互独立。</li>
</ul>
<hr class="my-8 border-t border-border"/>
<h2 class="group min-w-0 text-3xl font-medium mt-12 mb-4 text-foreground" id="next-steps">下一步<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h2>
